description: Create a new List directly under a Space (not inside any Folder), optionally setting description, due date, priority, default assignee and status. Returns the created List with its id.

assignee.description: User id set as the default assignee for new tasks in the List.

content.description: List description / notes shown at the top of the List.

due_date.description: Due date for the List. Accepts natural language ('tomorrow', 'in 3 days'), ISO date, or epoch milliseconds.

due_date_time.description: If true, the due_date includes a specific time of day (not just a date).

space_id.description: ID of the Space to create the List in.

status.description: List color/status name (the List's accent label).

name: create_folderless_list
